### What went well
- The workflow completed 24 out of 24 runs successfully with zero failures.
- Both the "Assess" and "Tutor" agents recorded 24 executions each with zero failures and zero tool failures.
- The "Teacher check" node successfully processed 24 decisions via the "e2_approve" route with a revise rate of 0.0.
- Out of 24 rated runs, 16 received a "good" rating.

### What is failing
- Out of 24 rated runs, 8 received a "bad" rating, accounting for $0.010112 of the cost.
- Because this count rests on fewer than five runs for failures, the specific failure type is a small sample hint rather than a firm finding.

### What to change first
- Investigate the 8 runs rated as "bad" to see why they failed to satisfy the rating criteria while the "Teacher check" node approved all 24 routes.

### What I cannot see from here
- I cannot see prompt text, model answers, tool arguments, or tool output.
- I cannot see embedding or search costs, nor anything from runs made outside this service.
